correctness.rationale: The exact identity x^(2)=alpha_0 alpha_1[(mu_0+mu_1)I-A]b follows from the two Cauchy steps, with each mu_k a Rayleigh quotient. For kappa<=2 the bracket is entrywise nonnegative on a Stieltjes matrix. The diagonal three-mode family gives the stated rational sign formula and a counterexample for every kappa>2. In two spectral dimensions the reciprocal steps sum to lambda_1+lambda_2 and the residual repeats after two steps by a scalar rho in [0,1), yielding explicit even/odd iterate formulas as nonnegative combinations of x* and b. Independent rational arithmetic reproduced the kappa=4 witness exactly.
